k2.prompt: The wolf spider walks forward over dewy moss, each leg lifting and placing deliberately, body steady; dew drops tremble as it passes. Locked-off macro camera, shallow depth of field. Deep black background, one low warm light from the left.

j1.prompt: The moon jellyfish drifts slowly upward, its bell pulsing in a steady rhythm, tentacles trailing and swaying; kelp sways gently and fine particles drift through the torchlight. Locked-off camera. Dark rock pool at night, one low side light.

j2.prompt: The jellyfish pulses and drifts slowly, long fine tentacles flowing behind it; bioluminescent plankton sparks flicker around it and the seagrass sways. Locked-off camera, close and low. Dark open water.

s3.prompt: The peacock spider steps forward across the dark moss, legs lifting deliberately, its iridescent blue and red body catching the light as it turns slightly. The moss stays still. Locked-off macro camera. One cool soft light, deep black background.

g1.prompt: The black leopard stays low on the sandstone ledge, head turning slightly as it watches, shoulders shifting, tail tip twitching; fine dust drifts through the torch beam and settles. Locked-off long-lens camera, shallow depth of field. Desert canyon at night, one low warm torch from the side, deep black sky.

h4.prompt: The shark glides slowly forward across the frame, tail sweeping, pectoral fin steady; blue bioluminescent plankton sparks and swirls in its wake where the fin cuts the water. Locked-off camera. Black open water at night over a pale sand plain, one low torch.

h8.prompt: The octopus eye slowly blinks and its pupil narrows; the skin ripples, papillae rising and colour cells flickering; the curled arm tightens and its suckers flex. Red sea whips sway gently. Locked-off macro camera. Black water at night, one low warm light.

e1.prompt: The orb-weaver spider sits at the hub of its frosted web, legs flexing slightly; the web trembles in a faint breeze, frost on the threads glinting as it moves, teasel heads nodding. Locked-off macro camera. Frozen meadow at night, one low torch, deep black beyond.

e5.prompt: The seahorse sways gently, tail gripping the sea fan branch, its small dorsal fin fluttering fast, eye turning; plankton sparks drift past and the sea fan lattice moves softly in the current. Locked-off macro camera. Black water at night, one low light.
